objective: SCALE-MEMORY-20261116-001#1 (coordinator go-ahead 2026-11-17; goals G15, G16; prerequisite for sub-goal B191). Scale-free memory held parity with Novelty+ across a 16x size range on rand but every arm lost 4.7-29x on the local pattern, where counts are not normalized by degree. Train agents with degree-normalized, fully scale-free reads on a mixture of meeting patterns (rand at two densities and a block pattern), hold out local, compare with widely re-tuned Novelty+ and probSAT with five runs per instance, with a rand-only control and a memoryless control. Stop at the frozen rule.
title: Does the navigating agent learned memory carry over to a meeting pattern it never trained on, when its reads are normalized by how many knots meet at a distinction and count no steps?
